description: This file defines the configuration class for the OpenID Authentication plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements plugin configuration interface, uses traits for service container management, and registers a social media authentication service during initialization.

classes.name: OpenidAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the OpenID Authentication plugin, registers social media authentication service during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the social media authentication service into the service container.
